Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 1113/2023

Dear Ms. Shetty,

Thank you for meeting us on 07/10/2023 about your dispute with Lakshmi Malhotra. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Lucknow.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹35,70,000.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor

spans.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Lucknow
